review.name: Ancient Frost Titan
findings: All twelve original raw source face/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Lower beard and jaw shear in authored head turns and recoil. Complete-face candidate preserves the sculpt and all authored curves, and all twelve candidate slices plus 216 equipped-technique frames actually inspected and pass. Shoulder and elbow/hand joins, hips, knees and feet remain connected. Separate rebuilt battle review still required.

Separate second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices across low and medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native equipped technique frames in twelve lossless strips and all sixteen atlas cells. All passed. Full geometry 203 poses per asset with zero warnings; original independent face landmarks and 468 blends pass. Complete crystal beard and side jaw binding preserves sculpt, topology, textures, rig, all authored animation curves and 21923 protected vertex palettes. Eight focused regression/animation-bank tests and production build passed. Whole roster and live release pending.
